topic: Uses of total station and electronic distance measuring instruments
source: survey 350-455 updated.json (merged from old LEVEL 7 archive)

questions.q: 438. The range of accuracy in measuring distance by EDM with respect to ODM is:
questions.explain: Electronic Distance Measurement (EDM) uses light or radio waves to reach accuracies of 1/100,000 or better, which is significantly more accurate than Optical Distance Measurement (ODM/Tacheometry).
A Distomat (brand name by Leica/Wild) is a highly precise Electronic (Electro-magnetic) Distance Measurement instrument that uses infrared or laser light.
The Tellurometer is an EDM instrument specifically designed to use radio waves (microwaves), which allows it to work over long distances even in foggy weather.

questions.explain: A Total Station is an integrated electronic instrument that combines a digital theodolite with an EDM (Electro-magnetic Distance Measurement) and a microprocessor.
Because it measures slope distance and angles simultaneously, it uses internal software to calculate all of the above, including 3D coordinates (X, Y, Z).
